Pre-Bid Meeting Information Pre-Bid Meeting Schedule Particulars Details Organizer Principal, Livelihood College, Korba (C. G.) – 495677 Date and Time (as per Gem pre-bid schedule) Venue / Mode Livelihood College, Korba Last Date for Submission of (before the meeting) Queries Query Submission In writing / by e-mail livelihood.korba @gmail.com Clauses on Pre-Bid Meeting 1. A pre-bid meeting will be held on the date, time and venue me ntioned above to clarify the bid terms, scope of work, eligibility cr iteria and technical specifications to prospective bidders. A worki ng demonstration of the offered product shall be conducted durin g the meeting as per the clauses below. 2. Attendance of an authorized representative of the bidde r at the pre-bid meeting and a live working demonstration of the offered agriculture drone are MANDATORY for all pa rticipating bidders. A bidder who does not attend, or does not complete the demonstration, shall not be eligible to p articipate and its bid shall be rejected. 3. Bidders must send the name and mobile number of their repres entative in advance. The representative must carry an autho rity letter on the firm's letterhead and a copy of the DGCA

Type Certificate of the drone model offered. 4. The drone demonstrated must be of the same make and model , with the same specifications, as offered in the bid, and must be brought with the complete kit (flight batteries, charger, controller with mobile app, spray system and accessories). Transport, batte ries, water and all other consumables shall be arranged by the bi dder at its own cost. 5. The working demonstration shall include, at a minimum: unfoldi ng and set-up of the drone; pre-flight checks; take-off, hover and landing; spraying operation with water payload; Auto / AB Point a nd map-based navigation; geofencing; Return-to-Home and other safety features; display of the mobile app in Hindi/English; and an y other test asked by the committee to verify compliance with the technical specifications. 6. The demonstration shall be held in the presence of the committ ee in a designated open area, in time slots allotted to each bidder . The committee shall record the compliance of the demonstrated drone against the technical specifications. 7. The flight shall be operated by a person qualified as per DGCA r ules. The bidder shall be solely responsible for flight safety, permi ssions, insurance, and any damage or injury during the demonstr ation; the department shall not be liable. 8. After successful demonstration, the department shall issue a si gned and stamped demonstration certificate to the bidder. This c ertificate shall be uploaded as a mandatory attachment with the online bid, and shall be treated as the certification required under the sample demonstration clause of this bid . Failure to upload it shall lead to rejection of the bid. 9. Attendance by other persons is at the bidder's own cost; the de partment shall not reimburse any expenses.

10. Queries must be sent in writing, clause-wise, on or before the l ast date for submission of queries. Queries received after this dat e, or raised only orally, may not be considered. 11. The department's replies given at the meeting are for clarificati on only and are not binding unless incorporated in the minutes an d issued as a corrigendum / amendment on the GeM portal. 12. Any amendment to the bid conditions, specifications or bid end date arising from the pre-bid meeting shall be published on the G eM portal only. Bidders must check GeM regularly and submit thei r bids in accordance with the corrigendum. 13. The minutes of the pre-bid meeting and the list of bidders who completed the demonstration shall be uploaded on the GeM porta l and shall form part of the bid document. 14. The department reserves the right to modify, add or delete any condition of the bid, to reschedule the demonstration or extend t he bid end date, without assigning any reason. . 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Payment online through RTGS / internet banking also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). On-line payment shall be in Beneficiary name Livelihood college korba Account No. 33750802697 IFSC Code SBIN0006047 Bank Name SBI Branch address SBI ITI Rampur . Successful Bidder to indicate Contract number and name of Seller entity in the transaction details field at the time of on-line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer in place of PBG within 15 days of award of contract. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of Livelihood College Korba payable at Principal Livelihood College Korba . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date.

5. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms.
